resolved_findings.check: transport arithmetic - recomputed independently, RE-VERIFIED ROUND 2
resolved_findings.claim: THE TWO-MIL RADIUS RECONCILES. The prior round's arithmetic MAJOR is genuinely repaired, not argued away.
resolved_findings.evidence: Para 4 states the observed boundary as a RADIUS: 'Nastan alla leverantorer visade sig bo inom drygt tva mil fran hyttan.' Para 4 then explains it: 'Tva mil, konstaterar han, ar ungefar sa langt ett hastekipage hann kora at ett hall utan att lasta om och anda vara hemma igen innan en kort vinterdag var slut.' Recomputation: one-way d = 2 mil = 20 km; round trip = 4 mil = 40 km within one short winter day - exactly the trip a supplier at the boundary makes, so explanation and observation agree. Under the SUPERSEDED wording ('motsvarar ungefar vad ett hastekipage hann fram och tillbaka') the round trip was 2 mil, giving a 1-mil radius, HALF the boundary the sentence exists to explain. Residual tension between 'drygt tva mil' (observed) and 'Tva mil' (explanation) is absorbed by the explicit hedge 'ungefar' and by in-text attribution ('konstaterar han').
resolved_findings.why: Real-world sanity band, checked rather than assumed: a loaded horse sled on frozen ground makes ~5-7 km/h, so 40 km is ~6-8 h of travel; the charcoal hauling season (frozen ground, sled, Jan-Mar) carries ~7-11 h of usable light in Bergslagen/southern Norrland, and pre-dawn departure on snow was standard practice. Demanding end of attested practice, but inside it, and hedged and attributed. No question turns on the figure.

findings.check: 1 / passage internal consistency - 'fyrtiotva ar i foljd' vs 'saknas hela band'. OPEN BY DESIGN, deferred to owner adjudication. IS THE CONTRADICTION TRULY MINOR? Answer: yes, minor - but real, not negligible.
findings.quote: Materialet ar ojamnt: for aren 1863 till 1866 saknas hela band, och en forestandare pa 1870-talet nojde sig med att skriva efternamn, men serien tacker anda fyrtiotva ar i foljd.
findings.claim: CONFIRMED A GENUINE CONTRADICTION, CORRECTLY CLASSIFIED MINOR, STILL OPEN IN THE SHIPPED TEXT AND CORRECTLY RECORDED AS OPEN IN THE REPAIR_LOG.
findings.evidence: 'Tacker ... i foljd' asserts unbroken coverage; 'for aren 1863 till 1866 saknas hela band' denies it for four named years. The concessive 'men ... anda' can carry the SECOND listed defect (surname-only entries do not break continuity) but not the first. Arithmetically: the works bought charcoal 'under 1800-talets andra halft', so a 42-year run fits inside 1850-1900, but with a four-year hole the covered total is 38, not 42. Independent verification that no question depends on it, re-run round 2: none of 'fyrtiotva', 'i foljd', 'saknas', 'hela band', '1863', '1866', 'serien', 'tacker', 'ojamnt', 'forestandare' or 'efternamn' occurs anywhere in any prompt, option, key or rationale.
findings.fix: 'men serien stracker sig anda over fyrtiotva ar' - preserves the concessive and is true. Passage edit, so deferred behind a passage re-gate (G-SPRAK x3 + G-REGISTER + mech).
findings.why: Minor on three grounds: (i) zero key, stem, option or rationale dependence, verified mechanically, so no student can be marked wrong by it; (ii) the concessive frame reads as authorial imprecision rather than a factual trap - a solver cannot be lured into a wrong answer by it; (iii) a strained but available reading attaches 'i foljd' to the series' SPAN rather than its coverage. Not negligible, though, and I decline to soften it on re-issue: this is the one sentence in the unit a native expert reader stops on, it ships in student-facing prose, and the fix is a three-word swap. It should be taken in the next passage-touching round rather than carried indefinitely.

real_entity_check.verdict: CLEAN - no same-domain collision found for any invented name. Law 16 satisfied. Carried forward from round 1; the round-2 edit touched no name, so no re-run was owed and none of the eight names, nor the title, changed.
real_entity_check.method: Four independent channels, all executed 2026-08-25 by this audit, not inherited from the unit's own originality_note: (1) sv.wikipedia CirrusSearch API exact terms; (2) en.wikipedia CirrusSearch API; (3) Wikidata (action=query list=search, and action=wbsearchentities per term); (4) K-samsok / kulturarvsdata.se fulltext - the Swedish heritage aggregator indexing Riksantikvarieambetet's fornlamningar and the county museums, i.e. the SAME DOMAIN as this passage's kolbottnar, tjardalar and bruk. Plus open-web search via Exa for every name. BOTH structured channels were control-tested before being trusted: the sv.wikipedia OR-query returns 0 for the invented terms but 18 for the same query with the known-real 'Kvarnasen' added (top hit: the village in Norsjo kommun), and K-samsok returns 669 for 'Kvarnasen' against 0 for the invented terms - so the zeros are real zeros, not a broken query or a dead endpoint.

verdict_rationale: REFUTE brief, and the unit does not refute - now on a second, post-repair pass.
